title: Dying Star PBR material
description: Structural contract for a material.json entry. Tag vocabulary and pixel-level rules are enforced separately (see tags.json and image_rules.py).

id.description: Stable identifier. Must match the folder name.

tags.description: Searchable keywords. Values are checked against tags.json.

physical_size_m.description: Real-world size covered by one UV tile, in meters [width, height]. Drives consistent tiling across the whole game world.

ai_generated.description: Project policy forbids AI-generated art, so only false is accepted.

notes.description: Free-form rationale for deliberate deviations (art direction choices, known limitations).

delivery.description: Where the binary maps come from.

maps.description: Map name to file name, relative to the material folder (hosted) or to the extracted archive (external).
maps.$comment: orm and ao/roughness/metallic are mutually exclusive. Expressing that here with not/required is possible but yields unreadable errors, so validate.py checks it explicitly.

fileName.$comment: Follows the project naming convention: tex_[descriptor]_[map].png

externalDelivery.description: Maps fetched from a third-party library. Nothing is hosted by the project.

hostedDelivery.description: Maps stored in this repository. Download URLs are derived from id, version and resolution, never written by hand.
